From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud

Thanks for the call this morning, Sam + Nina - good conversation.

Recap (post-call):
- Use case: GenAI assisted support (summarization + reranking) across customer tickets; expected 5M tokens/day steady state after pilot.
- Desired ETA: pilot in prod by end of Q2, full rollout in Q3.
- Security bar: SOC 2 + customer-specific IP handling; security questionnaire coming.

Procurement / commercial notes we discussed:
- Commercial path: PO preferred; card ok for initial POC if procurement timeline is blocking.
- Marketplace: You mentioned interest in marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) - that could speed procurement but depends on your procurement/finance team.
- Timeline (rough): legal review -> security review (questionnaire + evidence) -> finance (PO issuance). You estimated ~3-6 weeks if no major legal asks.

Next steps (owners & timeline):
1) I'll send a mutual action plan (MAP) doc and a proposed timeline for legal/security/finance (Marissa).
2) If you prefer Marketplace, confirm and we can share procurement instructions (Sam).
3) Camila (sec) + Laura (legal) from our side will start prepping the security questionnaire and standard contract terms.

Attachments: I attached the initial MAP (v1) for your review.

Can you confirm: (a) PO vs card for pilot, (b) whether Marketplace is preferred, and (c) any hard calendar constraints for legal/security?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud

Thanks Marissa - really helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Commercial path: Our finance team prefers PO for anything beyond a small POC. We can do a corporate card to get a POC started if needed, but PO is the long-term preference.
2) Marketplace: We are interested in using AWS Marketplace if Redwood is listed and the pricing/concessions are comparable. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports formal SaaS procurement via marketplace and whether the MAP changes in that case?
3) Timeline: Roughly: legal (1-2 weeks) -> security (2 weeks for questionnaire + evidence) -> finance (1 week to issue PO) - optimistic 4-5 weeks if no escalations. We will need a clear owner for the security evidence requests.

Can you send the MAP and any contract templates you typically use (SaaS agreement + MSA)? Also please include a billing contact so finance can loop them in.

Appreciate it - Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Platform Partnerships | AcmeCloud
sam.torres@acmecloud.com | +1-617-555-0133

Thanks Sam - sending the MAP and PO template now (attached). 

Quick answers:
- Marketplace: Redwood supports procurement via AWS Marketplace for select accounts. If you confirm Marketplace, the MAP mostly stays the same but billing/PO routing changes (we'll include marketplace ordering instructions).
- Owners: Camila will be the security evidence owner on our side and will reach out for specific artifacts. Laura will own standard legal terms and can fast-track common SaaS redlines.
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (I cc'd Marcus for contract/billing follow-up).

I've attached: AcmeCloud_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx and AcmeCloud_PO_template.pdf.

I'll plan a MAP check-in next Tue to confirm timeline & owners unless you'd prefer an earlier sync.
